```{=html}
<template id="tpl-music-player">
<div id="music-player">
  <fieldset>
    <ul class="tree-view">
        <details open>
        <summary>Music</summary>
        <ul>
        </ul>
    </ul>
    <canvas id="oscilloscope"></canvas>
  </fieldset>
  <fieldset>
      <div id="visual-toggles">
          <button style="justify-content: center; font-size: 1.2rem;" id="toggle-scope">Mode</button>
          <div><span>Stretch: <val id="stretch-value" class="toggle-value"></val></span><input type="range" id="stretch-slider" class="slider" min="1" max="50" step="0.01" value="2"></div>
          <div><span>Persistence: <val id="persistence-value" class="toggle-value"></val></span><input type="range" id="persistence-slider" class="slider" min="0" max="1" step="0.001" value="0.4"></div>
          <div><span>Draw Distance: <val id="distance-value" class="toggle-value"></val></span><input type="range" id="distance-slider" class="slider" min="0" max="0.1" step="0.001" value="0.09"></div>
          <div><span>Scale: <val id="scale-value" class="toggle-value"></val></span><input type="range" id="scale-slider" class="slider" min="0" max="0.6" step="0.01" value="0.55"></div>
          <div><span>Glow: <val id="glow-value" class="toggle-value"></val></span><input type="range" id="glow-slider" class="slider" min="0" max="10" step="0.01" value="6"></div>
      </div>
  </fieldset>
</div>
</template>
```
